structured_output.summary: The change implements encodeURI and the Encode abstract operation step by step as the spec describes. ToString is called first and its error propagates with `?`. The unescaped set is built as the spec says (word characters, "-.!~*'()", plus extraUnescaped). An unpaired surrogate throws a URIError. The UTF-8 octets are correct for 1 to 4 bytes, and each is written as "%" plus two-digit uppercase hex. The local CodePointAt helper correctly treats a lone trailing surrogate, or a leading surrogate with no trailing one after it, as unpaired. The 12 remaining test failures come from `String.prototype.toUpperCase`, which is not implemented and is outside this ticket. I found no special-casing, swallowed errors, made-up values or unrelated edits.
